title: AOS Live Use: Structured Action Logging
abstract: Logging the actions from the previous, successful tick.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 99

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="read_data",
    target="self_analysis_report_latest.txt",
    metadata={"purpose": "Final report review"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="update_meta",
    target="meta_prompt",
    metadata={"new_project": "Project Metis Phase 4"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_98",
    metadata={"eval_id": 238}
)
